grain: one extracted value of T5 pumped transfers and the accounting observation

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: run identity

columns.name: source_file_id
columns.description: stable per-file id inside this run

columns.name: bulletin_date_filename
columns.description: date parsed from the file name

columns.name: bulletin_date_printed
columns.description: date printed on the page, captured in the same pass

columns.name: rotation_normalization
columns.description: identity or derotated_<deg>

columns.name: row_label_raw
columns.description: label exactly as read, duplicates preserved

columns.name: row_label_ar
columns.description: normalized Arabic; empty when the regime makes it unrecoverable

columns.name: canonical_label_ar
columns.description: readable Arabic label from the semantic registry; unlike row_label_ar this is never garbled by the page's text regime, and it never replaces row_label_raw

columns.name: canonical_label_en
columns.description: readable English label from the semantic registry

columns.name: parsed_value
columns.description: null for every non-numeric state; never coerced to 0

columns.name: dam_id
columns.description: empty when the roster match is unresolved

columns.name: is_accounting_observation
columns.description: True only for the T5 restating row; never an edge

columns.name: evidence_id
columns.description: resolves to exactly one cell of one fragment

columns.name: extraction_status
columns.description: did this extractor read the cell faithfully? Says nothing about whether the source's arithmetic reconciles

columns.name: validation_status
columns.description: page-level verdict: the strongest result of every rule that ran on this fact's family. Not a per-fact quality filter - use extraction_status and source_consistency_status for that

columns.name: source_consistency_status
columns.description: does the bulletin's own printed arithmetic hold for this fact? Set only by rules that consumed this fact, so it never smears one page's disagreement over unrelated values

columns.name: recovery_method
columns.description: set only when the published value was reassembled from a token the page's word segmentation welded onto an adjacent label

columns.name: recovery_gate
columns.description: the printed identity that confirmed the reassembled value, or the reason it was refused

columns.name: recovery_evidence
columns.description: the value cell's own text, the assembled text, and every donor token with its box and character offsets

columns.name: dam_candidate_raw
columns.description: the row label exactly as the layer it was read from gave it; raw evidence, never a display label

columns.name: dam_candidate_normalized
columns.description: NFKC-normalised, tatweel- and bidi-control-stripped label with the parenthetical level qualifier separated and any numeric span content removed; the string the roster was matched against

columns.name: identity_status
columns.description: whether the entity behind this row is resolved, and if not why not; separate from numeric authenticity on purpose

columns.name: family_usability_status
columns.description: usability of this fact's own T-family on this page, equal to p3_family_status.family_status; a page whose only partial family is T2 is distinguishable from one with a T1/T3/T4/T5/T6 defect

migration_note: 1.3.0 (Phase 5C): additive only. dam_candidate_raw / dam_candidate_normalized separate raw label evidence from the string identity was matched against; identity_status separates entity identity from numeric authenticity; family_usability_status publishes the per-family status that p3_family_status already computed. No column was removed or renamed, so every row valid under 1.2.0 remains valid.
